description:
CRB is seeking a talented and motivated  Control System Developer  to join our growing team. In this role, you will be responsible for the programming, implementation, testing, and documentation of complex and technically sophisticated automated control systems. You will work collaboratively under the guidance of a Project Manager and potentially a Lead or Senior Control Systems Developer to deliver high-quality solutions for our clients.
 This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in shaping the future of a rapidly growing and innovative business. As we expand our capabilities and reach, you’ll have the chance to make a meaningful impact and grow alongside a forward-thinking team. While this position can be based at any CRB office across the U.S., we are especially interested in candidates located in or near  Kansas City, Omaha, or St. Louis .
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Design, program, and implement automated control systems for a variety of industrial applications.
 Configure, install, and troubleshoot PC/PLC hardware, software, and customer networks.
 Support system installation and commissioning at client sites.
 Provide in-house and on-site training for customer operators.
 Maintain confidentiality of sensitive client information.
 Deliver occasional after-hours support as needed.
 Collaborate with engineers, designers, partners, and clients in a team-oriented environment.
 Travel up to 35% for system installations and plant start-ups, including potential overnight shifts.
 Maintain a regular in-office presence.
 
 Associate degree in Computer Studies; Instrumentation and Controls; or equivalent combination of education and experience
 Ability to multi-task and handle multiple concurrent projects
 Passionate about problem solving and developing solutions
 Proficiency in the Microsoft Office software suite required
 Excellent organizational skills and mechanical inclination.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
 
 CRB is committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and it is our policy to provide equal opportunity to all people without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, age, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other legally protected category. Employment is contingent on background screening.

 CRB does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms or agencies. Any resume submitted to any employee of CRB without a prior written search agreement will be considered unsolicited and the property of CRB. Please, no phone calls or emails.

 CRB offers a complete and competitive benefit package designed to meet individual and family needs.

 If you are unable to complete this application due to a disability, contact this employer to ask for an accommodation or an alternative application process.
